requirements_summary:
Brookline requires a Private VPC deployment with the following audit logging deliverables: canonical JSON-Line log schema for all inference requests and control-plane events; SIEM export paths (Splunk HEC + syslog/TLS, S3 export for cold-archive, optional Datadog/Loki connectors); strict retention options configurable per-log-type (access logs: 7 years, inference traces: 3 years, admin/audit events: 7 years); immutable append-only export with SHA256 checksums for forensic verification; field-level PII redaction controls before export; TLS 1.2+ for all exports; logs encrypted at-rest with customer-managed KMS keys; ability to show key usage logs (KMS audit events) to auditors; admin console audit (model pinning, rollout changes, RBAC grant/revoke) with export to SIEM.

Log schema (summary fields required): timestamp, iso_timestamp, request_id, tenant_id, user_id (nullable/pseudonymized), model_id, model_version, route, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, latency_ms, status_code, error_code, kv_cache_hit (boolean), cache_hit_reason, response_hash, bytes_in, bytes_out, src_ip (anonymized per policy), region, egress_region, kmsg_key_id (KMS key identifier), key_operation (encrypt/decrypt/verify), auth_method, actor (admin/service), action, resource, trace_id.

SIEM integration notes: Splunk HEC preferred; deliver sample HEC events and recommended Heavy Forwarder deployment pattern in-customer VPC. Alternative flows: syslog->UF->Splunk, S3 batch export (parquet/jsonl) for long-term archive, or direct push to Datadog/Loki depending on customer SIEM. Provide mapping to CEF fields on request.
log_volume_estimate: Customer estimate: 500k inference requests/day initially. Expect ~1.2M log events/day when including control-plane and access logs. Rough storage: 50-80GB/day raw JSON -> ~55TB for 3 years (pre-aggregation). Need cost model vs sample aggregation/rollup policy.

Encryption in transit and at rest
